description: This Java source file defines the StreamingActor class, an Akka actor responsible for managing WebSocket streaming sessions, handling configuration, and delegating session messages within the Eclipse Ditto gateway streaming component.

classes.name: StreamingActor
classes.description: An Akka actor managing WebSocket streaming sessions, configuration, and message delegation within the Eclipse Ditto gateway.

classes.name: Control
classes.description: Enum for control messages used within StreamingActor to trigger actions like scraping stream counters and retrieving WebSocket configuration.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for instantiating StreamingActor with necessary dependencies.

methods.name: supervisorStrategy
methods.description: Returns the supervisor strategy for the actor, handling failure escalation.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior, including retrieving and modifying config, creating sessions, and handling unknown messages.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the current streaming configuration as a Config object.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Updates the streaming configuration and reschedules periodic tasks.

methods.name: getUniqueChildActorName
methods.description: Generates a unique name for child actors based on a counter and URL-encoded suffix.

methods.name: scheduleScrapeStreamSessionsCounter
methods.description: Schedules periodic scraping of the stream sessions counter.

methods.name: replyWebSocketConfig
methods.description: Replies with the current WebSocket configuration.

methods.name: updateStreamingSessionsCounter
methods.description: Updates the gauge for current streaming sessions based on child actors.
